description: This script automates the flashing process for wireless routers via TFTP, with specific instructions and procedures tailored to different router models (Linksys, Asus, Toshiba). It performs checks on input arguments, outputs usage or notes, and executes TFTP commands to upload firmware images based on the router type.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main logic that checks arguments, outputs instructions or executes the appropriate TFTP upload commands based on router type.
